prompt: Our support agent should prepare threaded email replies that a person can reopen and edit in Sendmux before approving a send. It may use customer-connected outgoing accounts. Which Sendmux workflow and skill should own this? Keep the answer at routing level.
assertions: The output routes saved threaded reply preparation and later send to sendmux-mailbox-agent.
The output says the draft can be reopened and edited before sending.
The output keeps the exact reviewed revision behind a human send-approval boundary.
The output routes connected outgoing account setup or policy administration to sendmux-management.
The output does not claim that a connected provider account bypasses mailbox send permission or sender policy.
